purpose: One pilot-ethene diagnostic of strict final-operator stopping; unchanged equations and acceptance tolerances; no production activation
authorization_basis: User continuation 2026-10-05 after proposed solver correction and bounded new acceptance batch

engineering_gates.explanation: Conservative acceptance-driver guards only, not universal chemical or resource-domain thresholds; epsilon*kappa <= approximately 2.3e-10. Small/nonfinite final-operator gap blocks comparable-root acceptance, with no changed occupations, regularization or tolerance.

threshold_basis: T04: same pinned raw engine, frozen ordinary stopping; T05: same exact D and raw arrays with independently contracted algebra; T06: frozen density stopping 2e-8 plus different Pulay endpoint allowance. Engineering candidate values frozen before first molecular execution; never relaxed after observations. P12/P13 unchanged from earlier contract.
state_selection: Same byte-identified D0, global closed-shell Aufbau 2/0. Compare density/occupied subspace and final recomputed non-DIIS operator; no equality claim for trajectories or MO signs. Different endpoints: ROOT_NOT_COMPARABLE, no research comparison.
resource_scope: One sequential diagnostic bundle of a new exact code identity; not per-mode resource qualification, not general-user resource calibration.
interpretation_candidate: Specified fixed-geometry conditional fixed-point functional response Eordinary-Econditional; not bond energy, experimental measurement, CT/POL decomposition, other-method equivalence or a proven variational minimum.
remaining_external_requirements: Real responsible method reviewer and scope receipt
A01-A18 applicable acceptance, including professional user trial
Independent phase/mode resource calibration before general-user production activation

Reduce hard process limit to 1 GiB with 1 GiB observed host/VM headroom; retain global persistent ledger ceiling 4 GiB and 7200 s. correction_basis: Repair stopping semantics in separately named production-candidate and independent-reference solvers; retain all old failures; this does not approve the method.

solver_strategy.legacy_small_step_trigger: density <= 2e-8 and previous/current energy change <= 1e-9 Eh
solver_strategy.endpoint: Recompute F/E at candidate D; all original qualification gates and candidate/current energy change <= 1e-9 Eh
solver_strategy.raw_aufbau_map: ||D_raw-D||F/max(||D_raw||F,1) <= 2e-8; same masked metric and global closed-shell 2/0
solver_strategy.failed_plateau_action: Clear DIIS history; next two cycles use raw F; no occupation, equation or threshold change
solver_strategy.MO_density_role: Final raw operator orbitals are diagnostic; last iteration orbitals retained separately; not a claim they reconstruct a failed returned D
